user.title: Home Upkeep
user.description: Set up the Home Upkeep panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Home Upkeep is already configured. Only a single instance is allowed.

import_from_json.name: Import from JSON export
import_from_json.description: One-time import of lists and tasks from a copy of the add-on's 'list_id'.json files.

path.name: Directory path
path.description: Path to a directory containing the add-on's 'list_id'.json files.

init.title: CalDAV sync (optional)
init.description: Home Upkeep works fine without this. Connect a CalDAV server, for example Radicale or Nextcloud, to keep lists in sync with apps like Tasks.org.

server.title: CalDAV server
server.description: Enter the address of your CalDAV server. Tasks are exchanged with it directly.

lists.title: Lists to sync
lists.description: Select every Home Upkeep list that should be kept in sync with the CalDAV server. Unselected lists stay local. Select none to turn syncing off.

collections.title: CalDAV collections
collections.description: Choose the CalDAV collection each list syncs with, or create a new one named after the list. Tasks are created, completed, re-opened, edited and deleted on both sides.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server. Check the URL and that the server is running.
error.invalid_auth: The server rejected the username or password.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the server to create the collection.
